verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes a scriptable Editor API and REST API for programmatic scene/asset manipulation, an official MCP server that lets AI agents modify project data, and a dedicated SplatTransform CLI that explicitly batch-converts, filters and merges many splat files at once — all supporting bulk, script-driven automation. However, there is no first-party documentation of a general 'select N items and batch-edit' UI or API primitive across arbitrary entity/asset types, so bulk operations must be assembled via the Editor API rather than a turnkey feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit API examples (e.g., batch asset renaming/prop updates across hundreds of entities) and independent hands-on evidence of large-scale automation runs.
